connector.name: Oura Ring by YasuakiOmokawa
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Oura Ring API v2 (sleep, activity, readiness, heart rate, workouts).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package oura-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yasuakiomokawa account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional. Alternative to `npx oura-mcp configure`. Both OURA_CLIENT_ID and OURA_CLIENT_SECRET must be set together.
